units: metres and radians; normalized key times

drill.source: Owner decisions, 27 Oct 2026: condensed loading drill of about 10 s (half-cock, prime, shut pan, charge, draw rammer, ram, return rammer, cock); lock delay, no misfires.
order: cast about (muzzle up forward of the left shoulder, left hand)
draw rammer (ramrod 0 to 1), swap to the rammer cue at full draw
return rammer: swap back at full draw, ramrod 1 to 0
drill.label: Key times are the authored choreography (the owner times were guides); presentation, not a drill manual.

cock.meaning: 0 down (fired), 0.5 half cock, 1 full cock; the node rotates about local +Z (gun +Z through the pivot) piecewise-linearly in degrees: down + (half - down) x cock / 0.5 below 0.5, half + (full - half) x (cock - 0.5) / 0.5 above
cock.label: Estimate (measured on the v3 model); down is the flint's closest approach to the closed frizzen, 30.2 mm short: the modelled cock cannot reach the frizzen

frizzen.meaning: 0 closed (pan shut), 1 open; closed + (open - closed) x frizzen degrees about local +Z
frizzen.label: closed Model; open Estimate

ramrod.meaning: Joint_Ramrod translates along local +X (gun +X) by ramrod x drawMetres; hidden while ramrodCue > 0.5
ramrod.grasp: anchor_interaction_ramrod [1.095,-0.04,0] at rest (RamrodTip centre); a root child that does not move, so add ramrod x drawMetres along +X
ramrod.label: drawMetres Model plus 18 mm margin (free of the front pipe at 0.912 m; 1.27 mm clear of the fore-end at full draw)

ramrodCue.source: copy of the Joint_Ramrod subtree of the v3 musket (asset a_0a31fd5eeb864b529202724a65de4623, revision r_f052d566fab74b82b005050758dd180a)
ramrodCue.rotationOrder: Euler XYZ, radians, in the right wrist joint frame
ramrodCue.meaning: replaces the copied Joint_Ramrod node's local position (its origin: the head end face on the rod axis) and rotation; scale stays 1; the rod runs back along the cue -X

grip.hold: right fist (rightOpen -1, rightThumb 1) round the rod; the head leaves the little-finger side, so the ram is made thumb up after the rammer is turned end over end

ramrodCue.swaps: At "swap to rammer cue" (draw) and "swap to ramrod" (return) the hand holds still at full draw and the cue coincides with the drawn Joint_Ramrod (measured in evidence/flintlock-1742-v14/)

cartridge.source: saved paper cartridge cue (asset a_2741cba5bb43444aa2159f8be8738d0c, revision r_df84200b038e429db40500966fd0faab, authoring/flintlock-1742-cartridge-v1.glb)
cartridge.rotationOrder: Euler XYZ, radians, in the right wrist joint frame
cartridge.meaning: replaces the cue root's local position and rotation; scale stays 1; visibility fraction, no ammunition-state authority
cartridge.axis: cue +X from the powder end (-0.042) to the ball end (+0.028); the ball end sits in the fist, the powder end leaves the thumb side

shoulderShift.frame: gun frame metres (the weapon root frame)
shoulderShift.sampler: the clip key times and smootherstep of game/animation-sampler.mjs
shoulderShift.meaning: Translation of each rig shoulder for this key. The hands asset bakes it on Joint_<side>Arm_<side>_shoulder. Browser: the live IK solves from rig.arms.<side>.shoulder and the baked translation carries the arm. Absolute-goal hosts (Unreal): add the sampled shift to the wrist effector and to the pole goal (the hand channels are relative to the unshifted rig wrist).
shoulderShift.why: The rig shoulders sit in the weapon root frame; turning the musket muzzle-up for priming and loading would otherwise carry them to the knees. Each key's shoulder is placed in camera space (to its own side, below the eyes, out of view) so that the arm reaches without stretch and the forearm meets the hand with a small wrist bend.

fire.meaning: Fire clip: trigger at 0, cock down by 15 ms, frizzen open 15-30 ms (pan flash), the game fires the shot at 60 ms; the hands absorb it and the clip ends at Fired. No misfires.

fingers.right: rightOpen +1 open, 0 Ready grip, -1 fist (rammer); rightIndex 1 presses the trigger (Ready pad gap closed); rightThumb +1 closes round the fist, -1 extends (cocking)
fingers.left: open 0 Ready grip, +1 released, -1 loading grip (fore-end, muzzle up); thumb +1 lifts
